translation.proposed_text_en: Contributions shall be valued in accordance with item 5; b) In the case of acquisition of a business for consideration, the assets shall be recognized at acquisition cost. 9. a) If a business, a part of a business or the interest of a partner who is considered as an entrepreneur (co-entrepreneur) of a business is taken over free of charge, the legal successor shall adopt the book values of the previous owner of the business (owner of the interest) (continuation of book values), b) If, for business reasons, individual assets are transferred free of charge into the business assets of another taxpayer, the amount that the recipient would have had to pay for the individual asset at the time of receipt shall be deemed as the acquisition cost (deemed acquisition cost).
issues: The content of referenced item 5 and the surrounding enumeration are not supplied, so the cross-reference cannot be substantively checked.

translation.proposed_text_en: For assets that already formed part of the business assets at the end of the preceding fiscal year, the taxpayer may in the following fiscal years recognize the partial value even if that value is higher than the last book value; however, at most the acquisition or production costs may be recognized. b) In the case of agricultural and forestry businesses, the valuation of assets subject to biological growth may be made at the partial value exceeding acquisition or production costs. c) In the statement of assets and liabilities (annual financial statement, balance sheet), a write-down of up to 15% of the amount of the receivable outstanding at the respective balance sheet date may be taken on foreign receivables if the following conditions are met: — The receivables were acquired from supplies pursuant to Section 6 nos. 1 to 3 of the Turnover Tax Act 1972 or from services performed abroad for foreign customers (Section 7(1) no. 1 of the Turnover Tax Act 1972). — The flat-rate write-down is reported for the first time in the balance sheet of the fiscal year in which the receivables arose. — The flat-rate write-down is reversed on a profit-increasing basis as the receivables are collected.
issues: Changed 'continue to carry them at their partial value' to 'recognize the partial value' because the German 'den Teilwert ... ansetzen' does not state that the same carrying basis must be continued.
The substantive scope of the cited Turnover Tax Act provisions cannot be checked from the supplied excerpt.

translation.proposed_text_en: If the land was acquired within the last ten years, the acquisition costs must not be exceeded. b) Upon transition from the profit determination method pursuant to Section 5 to another profit determination method, the hidden reserves of the land and the elective business assets must be disclosed and taxed.
issues: Changed 'voluntary business assets' to 'elective business assets' to reflect German 'gewillkürten Betriebsvermögens' without implying that the assets themselves act voluntarily.
The content of the profit-determination method in Section 5 is not supplied, although the direction of the transition remains explicit.
